Title: RuntimeError: Input and hidden tensors are not at the same device, found
Description: ## 🐛 Bug

I train LSTM for character level  text generation. At first I initialize hidden and cell with zeros using `torch.zeros`. Unfortunately this tensors are defaultly assigned to the cpu so I get the following error while training

```python
RuntimeError: Input and hidden tensors are not at the same device, found input tensor at cuda:0 and hidden tensor at cpu
```

llm_response:
I'll analyze this GitHub issue to determine if it requires a build environment to verify the solution.

CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is about a runtime error in PyTorch where hidden tensors are on CPU while input tensors are on GPU (cuda:0). The problem is clearly identified in the error message: "RuntimeError: Input and hidden tensors are not at the same device, found input tensor at cuda:0 and hidden tensor at cpu". 

The solution is also evident from the code and error message - the user needs to ensure that hidden and cell tensors are initialized on the same device as the input tensors. The user even mentions the solution in the "Additional context" section: "Problem can be solved by adding `.cuda()` to the variables".

This is a common PyTorch device mismatch issue that can be verified without building or running the code. The issue occurs because in the `init_hidden` method, tensors are created without specifying a device, defaulting to CPU, while the model is running on GPU. The fix would be to either:

1. Modify the `init_hidden` method to include device specification:
```python
def init_hidden(self, batch_size):
    hidden = torch.zeros(self.n_layers, batch_size, self.hidden_size, device=self.device)
    cell = torch.zeros(self.n_layers, batch_size, self.hidden_size, device=self.device)
    return hidden, cell
```

2. Or ensure the tensors are moved to the correct device after creation.

This is a conceptual issue about PyTorch device management that can be verified through code analysis without needing to build or run the code.
